title: Python from Zero to Pro
subtitle: Fifteen modules that take you from your first print() to decorators, async code and algorithms. Every module ends with a game you play by writing Python.

lines.title: Foundations
lines.summary: Write and run your first programs. Store data, then make decisions with it.

lines.title: Flow
lines.summary: Repeat work with loops and hold many values in lists, dictionaries and sets.

lines.title: Functions
lines.summary: Package code into functions, work with text and files, and handle errors calmly.

lines.title: Objects
lines.summary: Model the world with classes, then reuse code through inheritance and the standard library.

lines.title: Pro
lines.summary: Write idiomatic Python: comprehensions, generators, decorators, type hints and algorithms.
